introHtml: Evans bag clips are known for their durable construction and reliable grip, making them a favorite for food packaging and retail use. When you choose custom Evans bag clips, you get a product that withstands repeated use while keeping your brand front and center. Ideal for safety managers needing resealable solutions or marketing directors looking for practical giveaways, these clips can be decorated with your logo via pad printing or engraving. The 4-inch and 6-inch sizes offer versatility for various bag types, while the magnetic rip-and-clip design adds convenience for quick opening.
